content.comment_body: Hello, Can anyone assist me? I'm trying to access the data log, and I believe it's configured correctly. My project is quite large, using 29800 out of 30000 units of layout memory, but other parameters seem reasonable. Could this high memory usage be the reason the data log isn't working? Any assistance would be appreciated. --- Split from [company_name] [product_name] Logger.
Please share your project file here on the forum so it can be reviewed.
Thread closed because the question was submitted twice. A separate thread titled 'Data log is not found' was published in the same discussion area. Best regards [user_name] Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble retrieving a data log from a [company_name] [product_name] device and suspects the issue is related to high memory consumption by their program. The thread was closed for being duplicate, and no troubleshooting steps or technical recommendations were provided in the discussion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to retrieve the data log as planned regardless of memory usage or, at minimum, to receive a clear indication if the log cannot be retrieved due to resource limitations.
